description: This file defines data structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes for the xDSL hardware abstraction layer (HAL) interface, including DSL line and channel information, diagnostics, and callback registration.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_init
methods.description: Initializes and starts the DSL driver.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_registerDslLinkStatusCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to receive link status events from the driver.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslGetLineEnable
methods.description: Gets the enable status of a specified DSL line.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslSetLineEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified DSL line.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslSetLineEnableDataGathering
methods.description: Enables or disables data gathering for a specified DSL line.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_getTotalNoOfLines
methods.description: Returns the total number of DSL lines.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_getTotalNoofChannels
methods.description: Returns the number of channels for a given line.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslGetLineInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific DSL line.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslGetLineStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics counters for a specific DSL line.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslGetChannelInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific DSL channel.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslGetChannelStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics counters for a specific DSL channel.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslGetDiagnosticAdslLineTest
methods.description: Gets diagnostic information for ADSL line testing.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslGetDiagnosticSeltuer
methods.description: Gets diagnostic information for SELT UER test.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslGetDiagnosticSeltqln
methods.description: Gets diagnostic information for SELT QLN test.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslGetDiagnosticSeltp
methods.description: Gets diagnostic information for SELT P test.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslDiagnosticTestStart
methods.description: Starts a line diagnostic test of specified type.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslGetXRdk_Nlm
methods.description: Retrieves echo tone noise ratio measurement.
